chunks: After this the Pharaoh withdrew and settled his stratagem, then came back.
ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh do after receiving the divine message in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, Pharaoh's turning away (tawalla) signifies not merely a physical departure but a spiritual rejection of the truth, as he gathers his elite advisors to devise a counter-strategy against Moses. This consolidation of 'kayd' (stratagem) highlights the dynamic between divine truth and worldly power, illustrating how arrogance leads to the accumulation of resources for eventual confrontation. The verse underscores the inevitability of the clash between the Prophetic mission and the entrenched authority of the tyrant.
